description:
Found by the fz-da session while writing the lib exception modules; reproduced on develop + #469/#473/#474.

Repro: def main(), do: IO.inspect(:+)
fz2: error[parse/expected-token]: unsupported expression prefix in compiler2 front door: Colon. Elixir prints :+. The quoted form :"+" works in fz and prints :+ in Elixir.

Elixir accepts operator atoms without quotes (:+, :-, :*, :/, :==, :<>, :++, :&&, :||, :!, :|>, and the rest of its operator set). The lexer produces Colon followed by an operator token instead of one atom token.

Done when: a fixture lists Elixir's operator atoms, prints them, and matches Elixir on interp, run and build (fz-sc8 block, 01140 onward). Not on the distiller's path; end of the epic.
title: An operator atom such as :+ parses
